'''Yavin 4 Space Station''', also known as '''Yavin 4 Station''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] near to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was probably built by [[Nova Orion Industries]], as it was of the same type of space station as [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], which was known to have been constructed by the company.

It provided emergency repairs and cleared ships for landing at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] outposts on the moon.
